text: In 1939, as the Spanish Civil War nears its end, young Carlos is left at a remote orphanage with [an inert bomb in its courtyard|images|weapons and tools] and Republican gold hidden inside. At night he meets [the pale ghost of a boy with a bleeding head wound|threat|the restless dead], and a whisper warns that many of them will die. The missing boy was Santi, [killed by the groundskeeper Jacinto and sunk in the cistern|wrong|harm done to children], and [Jacinto is still hunting for the gold|wants|wealth and ambition].
